title: Retractable Wall Hook (Patent Pending), 2-1/2-Inch Extension, Carolina Collection, , Allied Brass
description:

Highlights:
- Keep towels and robes within reach, then reclaim space when not in use—retractable rod design
- Hang everyday items with confidence—supports up to 15 lb
- Match your bath hardware—available in multiple designer finish options and part of the Carolina collection for a coordinated look

- Install on standard interior walls—mounting hardware included with toggle bolts

- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 1.75 x 1.75 x 3.75 in.
- Weight capacity: up to 15 lb
- Wall installation: requires drilling a 3/4 in. diameter hole through drywall plus 3 small holes around
- Includes mounting hardware
